feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Federal judge restricts DHS field operations looking for noncitizen voters
entry.summary: The judge found the department's field operations to identify noncitizens who voted likely violated the Voting Rights Act, which bars voter intimidation.

entry.title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
entry.summary: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

entry.title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
entry.summary: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

entry.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
entry.summary: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

entry.title: Farm country has beef with Trump as midterms approach
entry.summary: President Trump's attempts to bring beef prices down has potentially backfired politically in several key states.

entry.title: High health costs squeeze workers, even if you have good insurance through a job
entry.summary: About 157 million Americans get their health insurance through work. A survey of employers shows a moderate price uptick this year, but workers still say health costs are a top concern.

entry.title: Backlash from attack ad upends Ohio gubernatorial race
entry.summary: An ad from Republican Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign for governor shows his opponent's mother calling her a liar, amid accounts by Democrat Amy Acton of an abusive childhood.

entry.title: Political communications expert discusses Vivek Ramaswamy's controversial ad
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political communications expert Jacob Neiheisel from the University of Buffalo about Vivek Ramaswamy's controversial ad.

entry.title: Kara Swisher on Elon Musk: 'He's unelected, unaccountable, enormously wealthy'
entry.summary: As Elon Musk considers merging Tesla and SpaceX, tech journalist Kara Swisher examines his business strategy, growing political influence and power over the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates
entry.summary: The pro-Israel lobbying group and influential political funder announced it would no longer endorse candidates or give directly to campaigns. AIPAC's affiliated super PAC, though, will continue.
